section_1_cloze.passage:
As a teenager, I was excellent at math. But when I entered high school, I had to study algebra. All of a sudden, everything was so [41]. Learning it seemed like knocking my [42] against the wall. I thought I would never comprehend, utilize it, or have the need for it.

Years later, I was engaged in a minimum wage job, [43] to support my young family. One day, I [44] myself with 10 dollars remaining until the next payday. The petrol tank of my shabby car was also empty, so I [45] at a convenience store and filled the tank with 5 dollars' worth of petrol. While I was about to [46] to pay, I noticed the female in front of me desperately [47] in her purse to find sufficient [48] to pay for 2 gallons of dairy products. For an instant, [49] held back my heart, but then I stepped forward and laid down my last 5 dollars to assist her in getting the [50]. As I left the [51], I was completely penniless, but my heart felt [52] and still seemed like the [53] man in the world. It didn't make sense in terms of mathematics. Maybe I didn't need to understand it but just enjoy it.

Life and love are much like algebra. They can be a [54] that we never fully comprehend. The truth is that the more we share love, the more it [55] within us.

questions.explanation: 作者提到自己本来擅长数学，但一上高中学代数，突然觉得一切都变得“抽象”了。因为代数包含字母和符号，比基础算术更抽象，这解释了为什么作者觉得难以理解。选项D符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(extraordinary)：语境句：She has an extraordinary memory and can remember everyone's name. 固定搭配：extraordinary ability, extraordinary achievement
B(absurd)：语境句：It is absurd to believe that the earth is flat. 固定搭配：absurd idea, entirely absurd
C(easy)：语境句：The exam was so easy that I finished it in half an hour. 固定搭配：easy to do, take it easy
D(abstract)：语境句：Algebra involves abstract concepts that can be hard to grasp. 固定搭配：abstract art, abstract concept

questions.explanation: 句意：学代数就像把我的头往墙上撞。这里考察英语固定习语“knock/bang one's head against a (brick) wall”，表示白费力气、做徒劳无功且令人沮丧的事。选A。
questions.supplement:
A(head)：语境句：Trying to convince him is like knocking your head against the wall. 固定搭配：knock one's head, keep one's head
B(leg)：语境句：He broke his leg while skiing in the mountains. 固定搭配：pull one's leg, break a leg
C(back)：语境句：He carried the heavy box on his back. 固定搭配：turn one's back on, back to back
D(feet)：语境句：After the long hike, my feet were completely sore. 固定搭配：stand on one's own feet, get cold feet

questions.explanation: 前文提到从事“minimum wage job（最低工资的工作）”，后文提到要“support my young family（养活年轻的家庭）”，因此作者在经济上是“挣扎的，艰难维持的”。选B。
questions.supplement:
A(determining)：语境句：He is determining the best way to solve the issue. 固定搭配：determine to do, determining factor
B(struggling)：语境句：The single mother is struggling to support her three children. 固定搭配：struggle to do sth, struggle for survival
C(preparing)：语境句：The students are preparing for their final exams. 固定搭配：prepare for, be prepared to do
D(promising)：语境句：She is a promising young artist with a bright future. 固定搭配：promising future, highly promising

questions.explanation: 固定句型 find oneself + 介词短语/分词，表示“发觉自己处于某种境地”。这里指作者发觉自己离下次发薪日只剩10美元了。选A。
questions.supplement:
A(found)：语境句：I woke up and found myself in a completely unfamiliar room. 固定搭配：find oneself doing sth, find out
B(made)：语境句：His hard work made him a successful entrepreneur. 固定搭配：make a difference, make sense
C(earned)：语境句：She earned a lot of respect through her dedication. 固定搭配：earn money, earn a living
D(presented)：语境句：He presented his passport to the customs officer. 固定搭配：present sth to sb, present itself

questions.explanation: 作者油箱空了，所以在一个便利店“停车”。pull up 意为“（车辆）停下，停车”，符合语境。pull out意为“驶出”；pull off意为“成功完成，靠边停车”；pull down意为“拆毁”。选C。
questions.supplement:
A(pulled out)：语境句：The train slowly pulled out of the station. 固定搭配：pull out of, pull out a tooth
B(pulled off)：语境句：Despite the difficulties, she managed to pull off the project. 固定搭配：pull off a deal, pull off the road
C(pulled up)：语境句：A black car pulled up in front of the hotel. 固定搭配：pull up at, pull up a chair
D(pulled down)：语境句：The old building was pulled down to make way for a new mall. 固定搭配：pull down a building, pull sb down

questions.explanation: 句意：当我要“排队”付钱时。根据常识，在便利店付款需要排队。queue意为“排队等候”。虽然选项A、B、C有停留之意，但排队付款最符合便利店的场景。选D。
questions.supplement:
A(stop)：语境句：We had to stop working because of the power cut. 固定搭配：stop doing sth, stop by
B(stay)：语境句：He decided to stay at home rather than go out. 固定搭配：stay up, stay away from
C(get)：语境句：You need to get permission before using the equipment. 固定搭配：get used to, get over
D(queue)：语境句：We had to queue for hours to buy the concert tickets. 固定搭配：queue up, jump the queue

questions.explanation: 句意：前面的女士拼命地在钱包里翻找。go in/into one's purse 或者 go through one's purse 表示“在钱包里翻找”。seek虽然有寻找之意，但是及物动词（seek sth），不接 in。选B。
questions.supplement:
A(filling)：语境句：She was filling the bottle with fresh water. 固定搭配：fill with, fill out
B(going)：语境句：She is going through her bag to find her keys. 固定搭配：go through, go in
C(seeking)：语境句：They are seeking help from the local government. 固定搭配：seek to do, hide and seek
D(breaking)：语境句：He is breaking the rules by leaving early. 固定搭配：break down, break into

questions.explanation: 女士在钱包里找足够的“现金”来付款买奶制品。钱包(purse)里通常装的是现金(cash)。选A。
questions.supplement:
A(cash)：语境句：I don't have any cash on me, can I pay by card? 固定搭配：pay in cash, short of cash
B(offers)：语境句：The company received several job offers from candidates. 固定搭配：special offer, make an offer
C(credit)：语境句：You can buy the goods on credit and pay later. 固定搭配：credit card, on credit
D(lists)：语境句：She made a shopping list before going to the supermarket. 固定搭配：on the list, shopping list

questions.explanation: 句意：有一瞬间，“自私”阻挡了我的心。因为作者自己也只剩5美元了，所以一开始犹豫不想帮忙，这是人性的“自私(selfishness)”。但随后作者克服了这一点，上前帮忙。选B。
questions.supplement:
A(generosity)：语境句：His generosity to the poor is well known in the town. 固定搭配：show generosity, act of generosity
B(selfishness)：语境句：Her selfishness caused her to lose many good friends. 固定搭配：out of selfishness, extreme selfishness
C(selflessness)：语境句：The hero's selflessness saved many lives during the fire. 固定搭配：act of selflessness, demonstrate selflessness
D(kindness)：语境句：A little act of kindness can brighten someone's day. 固定搭配：do sb a kindness, out of kindness

questions.explanation: 前文提到这位女士在找钱支付“2 gallons of dairy products（2加仑的奶制品）”，所以作者帮忙买下的就是“牛奶(milk)”。选D。
questions.supplement:
A(gas)：语境句：I need to stop at the station to get some gas. 固定搭配：gas station, run out of gas
B(money)：语境句：He saves a lot of money by cooking at home. 固定搭配：make money, spend money on
C(car)：语境句：She drives a small car to work every day. 固定搭配：by car, rent a car
D(milk)：语境句：Drinking a glass of milk before bed helps you sleep. 固定搭配：fresh milk, spill the milk

questions.explanation: 根据第45题可知，作者是在一家“convenience store（便利店）”里发生的这一切，所以这里是“当我离开这家商店(store)时”。选C。
questions.supplement:
A(woman)：语境句：The woman standing by the window is my teacher. 固定搭配：young woman, pregnant woman
B(line)：语境句：Please stand behind the yellow line. 固定搭配：in line, cross the line
C(store)：语境句：I went to the store to buy some daily necessities. 固定搭配：department store, convenience store
D(home)：语境句：It's getting late, and I want to go home now. 固定搭配：at home, feel at home

questions.explanation: 作者虽然把最后的钱给了别人导致“penniless（身无分文）”，但是内心充满了爱与帮助他人的喜悦，所以心是“充实的(full)”。与空空如也的口袋/油箱形成对比。选A。
questions.supplement:
A(full)：语境句：Though his wallet was empty, his heart was full of joy. 固定搭配：full of, to the full
B(empty)：语境句：The room was completely empty when we arrived. 固定搭配：empty promise, empty-handed
C(broken)：语境句：He tried to fix the broken chair with glue. 固定搭配：broken heart, broken English
D(surprised)：语境句：She was surprised to see her old friend at the party. 固定搭配：be surprised at, pleasantly surprised

questions.explanation: 前文说作者“completely penniless（身无分文）”，此处产生强烈的对比：“却感觉自己像是世界上最富有(wealthiest)的人”。wealthiest 相比 happiest 更好地呼应了 penniless 这个与金钱相关的词。选D。
questions.supplement:
A(happiest)：语境句：Winning the competition made him the happiest boy alive. 固定搭配：happiest moment, happiest memories
B(poorest)：语境句：He grew up in one of the poorest neighborhoods in the city. 固定搭配：poorest countries, the poorest of the poor
C(smartest)：语境句：She is considered the smartest student in her class. 固定搭配：smartest decision, smartest move
D(wealthiest)：语境句：He is known as one of the wealthiest men in the world. 固定搭配：wealthiest families, wealthiest nations

questions.explanation: 句意：生活和爱就像代数，它们可能是一个我们永远无法完全理解的“谜(mystery)”。后文强调爱越分享越多，不符合常理，所以是一种谜团。选B。
questions.supplement:
A(course)：语境句：I registered for an online course to improve my English. 固定搭配：of course, in the course of
B(mystery)：语境句：How the pyramids were built remains a mystery. 固定搭配：solve a mystery, remain a mystery
C(problem)：语境句：We need to find a solution to this urgent problem. 固定搭配：solve a problem, no problem
D(skill)：语境句：Communication is an essential skill in the workplace. 固定搭配：practical skill, communication skill

questions.explanation: 句意：事实是，我们分享的爱越多，它在我们内心就越“膨胀/增加(expands)”。这不符合数学减法规律，但符合爱的规律。expands意为扩大、增加，符合语境。选C。
questions.supplement:
A(sees)：语境句：He sees a bright future for the company. 固定搭配：see to it that, see off
B(takes)：语境句：It takes time and effort to master a new language. 固定搭配：take place, take apart
C(expands)：语境句：Water expands when it freezes into ice. 固定搭配：expand on, expand one's horizons
D(exchanges)：语境句：The two teams exchanged gifts before the match started. 固定搭配：exchange ideas, in exchange for

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be very good at something
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 擅长；在某方面表现出色
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 was 是 be 的过去式，主语 I 为第一人称单数；be excellent at 是固定短语，后接名词或动名词表示擅长的领域。
vocab_pack.example_en: She is excellent at solving complex problems.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她非常擅长解决复杂问题。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "I was excellent at math."

vocab_pack.definition_en: must; be obliged to
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 had 是 have 的过去式，表示过去的必须义务；have to 后接动词原形 study。
vocab_pack.example_en: We have to finish the project by Friday.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们必须在周五前完成这个项目。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "I had to study algebra."

vocab_pack.definition_en: suddenly; unexpectedly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 固定短语，在句中作时间状语，通常置于句首或句中，强调事件发生的突然性。
vocab_pack.example_en: All of a sudden, the lights went out.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 突然，灯灭了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "All of a sudden, everything was so abstract."

vocab_pack.definition_en: existing in thought or as an idea but not having a physical reality
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作表语，与 was 构成系表结构，so 副词修饰 abstract，表示“如此抽象”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The concept of freedom is abstract.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 自由的概念是抽象的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "everything was so abstract."

vocab_pack.term: knock one's head against the wall
vocab_pack.form_in_passage: knocking my head against the wall
vocab_pack.definition_en: to waste effort on something impossible or frustrating
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 白费力气；做徒劳无益的事
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为动名词短语作主语补足语；knocking 是 knock 的现在分词，后接宾语 my head 和介词短语 against the wall；one's 根据主语替换为 my。
vocab_pack.example_en: Studying this theory feels like knocking my head against the wall.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学习这个理论就像在徒劳地撞墙。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "Learning it seemed like knocking my head against the wall."

vocab_pack.definition_en: to understand something completely
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词原形，与 would 构成过去将来时，用于虚拟语气 I thought I would never comprehend… 表示“我原以为永远无法理解”。
vocab_pack.example_en: It is difficult to comprehend the full extent of the problem.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 很难理解这个问题的全部范围。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "I thought I would never comprehend, utilize it, or have the need for it."

vocab_pack.definition_en: to use something for a practical purpose
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 与 comprehend 并列，动词原形，与 would 构成过去将来时，表示“利用”。
vocab_pack.example_en: We must utilize all available resources.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们必须利用所有可用的资源。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "I thought I would never comprehend, utilize it, or have the need for it."

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be involved in an activity
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动语态，was 是 be 的过去式，engaged 是过去分词，in 为介词，后接名词短语 a minimum wage job。
vocab_pack.example_en: He is engaged in medical research.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他从事医学研究。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "I was engaged in a minimum wage job."

vocab_pack.definition_en: the lowest wage permitted by law for an employer to pay an employee
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语作定语修饰 job，表示“最低工资的工作”；minimum 为形容词起修饰作用。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many college students work part-time for minimum wage.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多大学生兼职只挣最低工资。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "I was engaged in a minimum wage job."

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make great efforts to do something difficult
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 努力（做某事）；挣扎着（做某事）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语作伴随状语，struggling 是 struggle 的现在分词，后接不定式 to support 表示目的；描述主句主语“我”的状态。
vocab_pack.example_en: She struggles to make ends meet every month.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她每个月都勉强度日。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "struggling to support my young family."

vocab_pack.definition_en: to realize that one is in a particular situation
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 发现自身处于某种状况（常含意外）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去时，found 是 find 的过去式，反身代词 myself 作宾语，with 介词短语表示伴随状态。
vocab_pack.example_en: After the trip, I found myself with no money left.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 旅行后，我发现自己身无分文。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "I found myself with 10 dollars remaining until the next payday."

vocab_pack.definition_en: the day on which an employee is paid wages
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词作宾语，the next payday 意为“下一个发薪日”，next 限定时间。
vocab_pack.example_en: I always look forward to payday.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我总是盼望着发薪日。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "until the next payday."

vocab_pack.definition_en: in poor condition because of age or use
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作定语修饰 car，表示汽车破旧。
vocab_pack.example_en: He wore a shabby old coat.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他穿着一件破旧的外套。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "my shabby car"

vocab_pack.definition_en: to drive a vehicle and stop it
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去时，pulled 是 pull 的过去式，up 为副词，后接介词 at 引出地点。
vocab_pack.example_en: The driver pulled up in front of the gate.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 司机在大门前停了下来。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "I pulled up at a convenience store"

vocab_pack.definition_en: to put something into a container until it is full
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去时，filled 是 fill 的过去式；结构为 fill + 宾语 + with + 填充物。
vocab_pack.example_en: She filled the bottle with water.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她用瓶子装满了水。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "filled the tank with 5 dollars' worth of petrol."

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be going to do something very soon
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去时，was 是 be 的过去式，后接动词原形 queue，表示过去即将发生的动作。
vocab_pack.example_en: I was about to leave when the phone rang.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我正要离开，电话响了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "While I was about to queue to pay"

vocab_pack.definition_en: to wait in a line of people to get something or do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词原形，与 be about to 连用，表示正要排队；不定式 to pay 为目的状语。
vocab_pack.example_en: People queued up for tickets hours in advance.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 人们提前几小时排队买票。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "to queue to pay"

vocab_pack.definition_en: in a way that shows great despair or need
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 副词修饰动词 going，表示“绝望地翻找”。
vocab_pack.example_en: He desperately searched for his lost keys.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他拼命寻找丢失的钥匙。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "the female in front of me desperately going in her purse"

vocab_pack.definition_en: enough; adequate
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词修饰 cash，作 find 的宾语补足语（或定语），表示“足够的现金”。
vocab_pack.example_en: We have sufficient time to finish the task.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们有足够的时间完成任务。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "to find sufficient cash"

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give money in exchange for something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式结构 to pay for，pay 是动词原形，for 为介词，后接宾语 2 gallons of dairy products。
vocab_pack.example_en: I will pay for the meal.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我来付这顿饭钱。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "to pay for 2 gallons of dairy products."

vocab_pack.definition_en: for a very brief moment
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语作时间状语，置于句首，表示极其短暂的时间。
vocab_pack.example_en: For an instant, I hesitated before answering.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 一瞬间，我在回答前犹豫了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "For an instant, selfishness held back my heart"

vocab_pack.definition_en: to prevent an emotion or action from being expressed
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去时，held 是 hold 的过去式，back 为副词，宾语 my heart 为被抑制的东西。
vocab_pack.example_en: She held back her tears.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她忍住了眼泪。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "selfishness held back my heart"

vocab_pack.definition_en: to move forward or offer help
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去时，stepped 是 step 的过去式，forward 为副词，表示迈步向前。
vocab_pack.example_en: No one stepped forward to volunteer.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 没有人主动站出来自愿帮忙。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "I stepped forward and laid down my last 5 dollars"

vocab_pack.definition_en: to put something down, especially money or something you are carrying
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去时，laid 是 lay 的过去式，down 为副词，宾语 my last 5 dollars。
vocab_pack.example_en: He laid down his tools and took a break.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他放下工具休息了一下。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "laid down my last 5 dollars to assist her"

vocab_pack.definition_en: to help someone do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式结构 to assist her in getting…，assist 为动词原形，后接间接宾语 her，in 为介词，后接动名词 getting。
vocab_pack.example_en: The teacher assisted the students in completing the project.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 老师帮助学生们完成了项目。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "to assist her in getting the milk."

vocab_pack.definition_en: having no money; very poor
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 身无分文的；一贫如洗的
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作表语，与系动词 was 构成系表结构，completely 副词修饰，表示彻底身无分文。
vocab_pack.example_en: After paying all the bills, I was left penniless.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 付清所有账单后，我身无分文。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "I was completely penniless"

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be reasonable or logical
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 用于否定句 it didn't make sense，didn't 为过去时否定，make 是动词原形，sense 为宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: His explanation makes perfect sense.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他的解释完全合乎情理。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "It didn't make sense in terms of mathematics."

vocab_pack.definition_en: with regard to; concerning
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语，在句中作状语，表示从数学的角度来说。
vocab_pack.example_en: In terms of cost, this solution is more efficient.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 从成本角度来看，这个方案更有效。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "It didn't make sense in terms of mathematics."

vocab_pack.definition_en: to take pleasure in something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 与 understand 并列，enjoy 为动词原形；原文省略了 to（但 not need to understand… but just enjoy it 中 enjoy 前无 to，视为并列不定式省略 to）。
vocab_pack.example_en: I enjoy reading books in my free time.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我喜欢在空闲时间读书。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "Maybe I didn't need to understand it but just enjoy it."

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: the more we share love, the more it expands
vocab_pack.definition_en: used to indicate that two things increase together
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 固定句型，第一个 the more + 从句表示条件，第二个 the more + 主句表示结果；两个分句都用一般现在时。
vocab_pack.example_en: The more you practice, the better you will become.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你练习得越多，就变得越好。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "the more we share love, the more it expands within us."

section_2_word_form.passage:
Lion dance roars with shared values

The powerful people-to-people bonds between China and Malaysia take many expressions considering the range of shared traditional and [56] values between the two nations. The Malay people have taken great interest in the lion dance, a tradition [57] emerged over a thousand years ago in China and has many admirers in modern Malaysia.

Among them [58] Adzwin Puteri Faizal, a petite young woman, who is part of the locally renowned Yong Jun Lion Dance Association. "In earlier generations, it was difficult for people from other ethnic groups and women [59] lion dance, but things have changed. The [60] and inclusiveness of lion dance have allowed us to build a family here," her lion dance master said. The lion dance in Malaysia shares its roots with the Chinese lion dance, [61] from the southern lion dance style. It arrived in Malaysia with Chinese immigrants and took root. Initially, the lion dance [62] during Chinese festivals and celebrations, but [63] the blending of Malaysia's ethnicities (种族特点) and cultures, it gradually crossed ethnic and religious boundaries, [64] a beloved cultural activity for all communities. Its cultural value is widely recognized by the public.

2024 marks the 50th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic ties between China and Malaysia. Both sides celebrated the lion dance as [65] form of shared history, and jointly promoted and safeguarded the heritage.

questions.explanation: 空前有并列连词and，前面是形容词traditional，空后是名词values，因此这里需要填culture的形容词形式cultural，作定语修饰values。意为“文化价值观”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(cultural)：语境句：The festival is an important cultural event for the local people. 固定搭配：cultural diversity, cultural heritage。原词culture其它变形：culture (n. 文化), culturally (adv. 文化上地)。

questions.explanation: 分析句子结构，emerged over a thousand years ago... 是一个定语从句，修饰先行词a tradition。从句中缺少主语，先行词是物，因此填关系代词that或which。
questions.supplement: 正确形(that/which)：语境句：This is the book that/which changed my perspective on life. 固定搭配：in which, all that。

questions.explanation: 这里是倒装句 Among them is Adzwin...。主语是后置的 Adzwin Puteri Faizal，属于第三人称单数。全文描述的是客观事实和现状，时态用一般现在时，故填is。
questions.supplement: 正确形(is)：语境句：Among the students is a boy from Africa. 固定搭配：there is, is doing。原词be其它变形：are, was, were, been, being。

questions.explanation: 考察固定句型：It is + adj. + for sb. + to do sth.，此处表示“对其他族群的人和女性来说，学习舞狮曾是困难的”，故填动词不定式to learn作真正的主语。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to learn)：语境句：It is essential for us to learn a foreign language. 固定搭配：learn to do, learn from。原词learn其它变形：learning (n./v-ing), learned (adj. 博学的 / v-ed)。

questions.explanation: 定冠词The之后需要名词，且与and后面的名词inclusiveness（包容性）并列。unique的名词形式是uniqueness，意为“独特性”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(uniqueness)：语境句：The uniqueness of this artwork makes it highly valuable. 固定搭配：appreciate the uniqueness, cultural uniqueness。原词unique其它变形：uniquely (adv. 独特地)。

questions.explanation: 此处修饰后面的介词短语 from the southern lion dance style（源自南狮风格），需要用副词形式。specific的副词是specifically，意为“具体地、明确地”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(specifically)：语境句：These tools were designed specifically for beginners. 固定搭配：specifically designed, more specifically。原词specific其它变形：specific (adj. 具体的), specifics (n. 细节)。

questions.explanation: 句子的主语是the lion dance，与perform之间是被动关系，且由时间状语Initially（最初）可知，表示过去发生的事情，应使用一般过去时的被动语态，故填was performed。
questions.supplement: 正确形(was performed)：语境句：The surgery was successfully performed by an expert. 固定搭配：perform a task, perform well。原词perform其它变形：performance (n. 表演), performer (n. 表演者), performing (adj. 表演的)。

questions.explanation: 句意：但是“随着”马来西亚种族和文化的融合，它逐渐跨越了界限。这里考查伴随状语或原因状语，用介词with表示“随着……”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(with)：语境句：With the development of technology, life has become much easier. 固定搭配：with the help of, come up with。

questions.explanation: 前文“it gradually crossed ethnic and religious boundaries”是一个完整的句子。逗号后用非谓语动词作结果状语，表示自然而然的结果，主动语态，故填现在分词becoming。
questions.supplement: 正确形(becoming)：语境句：The company expanded rapidly, becoming the largest in the country. 固定搭配：become of, become accustomed to。原词become其它变形：became (v-ed), becomes (单三)。

questions.explanation: form此处为可数名词单数，表示“一种形式”，泛指概念，且form的发音以辅音音素开头，故填不定冠词a。
questions.supplement: 正确形(a)：语境句：Dancing is a great form of exercise. 固定搭配：a form of, in the form of。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a traditional Chinese dance performed by performers mimicking a lion's movements
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 舞狮（一种中国传统表演）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作主语或宾语，可数名词短语，这里泛指舞狮这一文化活动。
vocab_pack.example_en: The lion dance is often performed during the Spring Festival to bring good luck.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 舞狮常在春节期间表演以带来好运。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The Malay people have taken great interest in the lion dance

vocab_pack.definition_en: to manifest in various forms
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文一般现在时，主语为复数（bonds），take 用原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: Cultural heritage can take many expressions across different regions.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 文化遗产在不同地区可以有多种表现形式。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The powerful people-to-people bonds between China and Malaysia take many expressions

vocab_pack.definition_en: common beliefs or principles held by a group
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文作介词 with 的宾语，复数形式。
vocab_pack.example_en: The two countries have many shared values that strengthen their friendship.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 两国拥有许多共同价值观，加强了友谊。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Lion dance roars with shared values

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become very interested in something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为现在完成时（have taken），表示从过去持续到现在的兴趣；主语复数。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many students take great interest in learning traditional Chinese painting.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多学生对学习中国传统绘画产生浓厚兴趣。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The Malay people have taken great interest in the lion dance

vocab_pack.definition_en: to come into existence or become known
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为一般过去时（emerged），描述一项传统在一千多年前出现。
vocab_pack.example_en: New traditions often emerge from cultural exchanges.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 新传统常从文化交流中涌现。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a tradition that emerged over a thousand years ago

vocab_pack.definition_en: a person who respects or enjoys something or someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为可数名词复数，作 has 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The artist has many admirers around the world.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这位艺术家在世界各地有很多崇拜者。
vocab_pack.from_passage: has many admirers in modern Malaysia

vocab_pack.definition_en: small and slender in build
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作定语修饰 young woman，为形容词原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: She is a petite dancer with remarkable strength.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她是一位娇小的舞者，却拥有非凡的力量。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Adzwin Puteri Faizal, a petite young woman

vocab_pack.definition_en: widely known and respected in a particular area
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为形容词短语，作前置定语修饰协会名称。
vocab_pack.example_en: The café is locally renowned for its homemade cakes.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家咖啡馆因其自制蛋糕在当地享有盛誉。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the locally renowned Yong Jun Lion Dance Association

vocab_pack.definition_en: people who lived before the current generation
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文作介词 in 的宾语，泛指过去几代人。
vocab_pack.example_en: In earlier generations, letter writing was the main form of communication.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在前几代人中，写信是主要的沟通方式。
vocab_pack.from_passage: In earlier generations, it was difficult for people from other ethnic groups…

vocab_pack.definition_en: to present a challenge to someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为一般过去时（was difficult for），it 作形式主语，真正主语为不定式短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: It is difficult for beginners to master the lion dance.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 对初学者来说，掌握舞狮是困难的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: it was difficult for people from other ethnic groups and women to learn lion dance

vocab_pack.definition_en: the quality of being one of a kind
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为不可数名词，与 inclusiveness 并列作主语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The uniqueness of the performance attracted a large audience.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 表演的独特性吸引了大批观众。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The uniqueness and inclusiveness of lion dance have allowed us to build a family here

vocab_pack.definition_en: the practice of including people who might otherwise be excluded
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为不可数名词，与 uniqueness 并列作主语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The inclusiveness of the festival welcomes people from all backgrounds.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个节日的包容性欢迎来自各种背景的人。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The uniqueness and inclusiveness of lion dance have allowed us to build a family here

vocab_pack.definition_en: to create a close-knit group like a family
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 建立一个大家庭（比喻意义）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为不定式短语，作 allowed us 的宾语补足语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The community center helped them build a family of supportive volunteers.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 社区中心帮助他们建立了一个支持性的志愿者大家庭。
vocab_pack.from_passage: have allowed us to build a family here

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have a common origin with
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为一般现在时，主语单数（lion dance），shares 带第三人称单数-s。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many modern languages share roots with ancient Latin.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多现代语言与古拉丁语有共同根源。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The lion dance in Malaysia shares its roots with the Chinese lion dance

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become established or settled
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为一般过去时（took root），描述舞狮在马来西亚落地生根。
vocab_pack.example_en: The custom took root in the local culture over time.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个习俗随着时间在当地文化中扎根。
vocab_pack.from_passage: It arrived in Malaysia with Chinese immigrants and took root.

vocab_pack.definition_en: at first; in the beginning
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为句首副词，修饰整个句子，首字母大写。
vocab_pack.example_en: Initially, only a few people attended the event.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 起初只有少数人参加活动。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Initially, the lion dance was performed during Chinese festivals and celebrations

vocab_pack.definition_en: to carry out a show or activity in front of an audience
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为被动语态（was performed），过去分词表示被表演。
vocab_pack.example_en: The lion dance is often performed during festive seasons.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 舞狮常在节日期间表演。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the lion dance was performed during Chinese festivals and celebrations

vocab_pack.definition_en: the process of mixing or combining
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为不可数名词，与 of 连用构成介宾短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The blending of different musical styles created a unique sound.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 不同音乐风格的融合创造出独特的声音。
vocab_pack.from_passage: with the blending of Malaysia's ethnicities and cultures

vocab_pack.definition_en: to go beyond limits or borders
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为一般过去时（crossed），及物动词短语，后接宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Music can cross boundaries of language and culture.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 音乐可以跨越语言和文化的界限。
vocab_pack.from_passage: it gradually crossed ethnic and religious boundaries

vocab_pack.definition_en: dearly loved; very popular
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作定语修饰 cultural activity。
vocab_pack.example_en: The lion dance is a beloved tradition in many communities.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 舞狮在许多社区是深受喜爱的传统。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a beloved cultural activity for all communities

vocab_pack.definition_en: an event or practice related to a society's culture
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为可数名词短语，作表语，主语为 it。
vocab_pack.example_en: Dragon boat racing is a popular cultural activity in China.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 赛龙舟是中国受欢迎的文化活动。
vocab_pack.from_passage: becoming a beloved cultural activity for all communities

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be acknowledged or accepted by someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为被动语态（is recognized by），recognized 为过去分词，by 引出施动者。
vocab_pack.example_en: The value of traditional art is widely recognized by the younger generation.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 传统艺术的价值被年轻一代广泛认可。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Its cultural value is widely recognized by the public.

vocab_pack.definition_en: over a large area or by many people
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作副词修饰动词 recognized。
vocab_pack.example_en: The practice is widely accepted in modern society.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这种做法在现代社会被广泛接受。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Its cultural value is widely recognized by the public.

vocab_pack.definition_en: the annual recurrence of a date marking a notable event
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为可数名词单数，与序数词 50th 连用，作主语补语。
vocab_pack.example_en: 2024 marks the 50th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic ties.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 2024年是建交50周年。
vocab_pack.from_passage: 2024 marks the 50th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic ties

vocab_pack.definition_en: official relations between countries
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为复数名词，作介词 of 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The two nations established diplomatic ties in 1972.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 两国于1972年建立外交关系。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the establishment of diplomatic ties between China and Malaysia

vocab_pack.definition_en: to support or actively encourage
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为一般过去时（promoted），与 safeguarded 并列作谓语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Schools often promote cultural heritage through special events.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学校常通过特别活动推广文化遗产。
vocab_pack.from_passage: jointly promoted and safeguarded the heritage

vocab_pack.definition_en: to protect something from harm or loss
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为一般过去时（safeguarded），与 promoted 并列。
vocab_pack.example_en: It is our responsibility to safeguard intangible cultural heritage.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 保护非物质文化遗产是我们的责任。
vocab_pack.from_passage: jointly promoted and safeguarded the heritage

vocab_pack.definition_en: traditions, achievements, or cultural values passed down
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为不可数名词，作宾语，前有定冠词 the。
vocab_pack.example_en: We must preserve our cultural heritage for future generations.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们必须为后代保护文化遗产。
vocab_pack.from_passage: jointly promoted and safeguarded the heritage

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make a loud deep sound (also used metaphorically for vitality)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为一般现在时第三人称单数（roars），主语 lion dance。
vocab_pack.example_en: The festival roars with excitement and joy.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 节日充满了兴奋和欢乐。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Lion dance roars with shared values

vocab_pack.definition_en: connections and relationships between ordinary people of different countries
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为复数名词短语，作主语，用复数谓语 take。
vocab_pack.example_en: People-to-people bonds are essential for international understanding.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 人民之间的纽带对国际理解至关重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The powerful people-to-people bonds between China and Malaysia

vocab_pack.definition_en: a variety of; a series of
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中与 the 连用（the range of），后接名词短语，作 considering 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The school offers a wide range of extracurricular activities.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学校提供广泛的课外活动。
vocab_pack.from_passage: considering the range of shared traditional and cultural values

vocab_pack.definition_en: taking into account; in view of
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为介词，位于句首，后接名词短语，引导原因状语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Considering the weather, the event was a great success.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 考虑到天气，这次活动非常成功。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Considering the range of shared traditional and cultural values

vocab_pack.definition_en: a community of people who share a common cultural or racial background
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为复数形式（ethnic groups），作介词 from 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: People from different ethnic groups coexist peacefully in this city.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 来自不同族群的人在这个城市和平共处。
vocab_pack.from_passage: people from other ethnic groups and women
